title: MCP servers with write access to one project load in every directory
symptoms: Tools for one client's systems are available in an unrelated folder
cause: Servers in the top-level mcpServers block of ~/.claude.json load in every working directory.
fix: Register servers under each project's own block and keep the top-level block empty unless a server truly belongs everywhere.
apply: Move entries from mcpServers to projects["/path/to/project"].mcpServers in ~/.claude.json, after backing the file up
